_doc: Secret realms (W-005, SecretRealms). Each realm opens every period_years years, first at offset_years after the game starts, and stays open open_days days. Only cultivators from min_realm to max_realm (realms.json ids) pass its barrier, and only from its region (regions.json id). entry_stones: spirit stones paid on the first entry of each opening. floors are cleared in order, one per entry, and progress resets at the next opening. Per floor: name, text, days (time spent), guardian (enemies.json id or ""; it must be beaten to claim the floor), treasures: [{weight, effects}] (one is drawn per floor; effects use the shared Effects keys, items/qi recommended); a floor's days must be fewer than open_days. W-005d: a floor that would last past the realm's closing casts the delver out with no treasure after the days left, inflicting the optional expulsion_injury (injuries.json id). Optional inheritance {name, text, min_comprehension, effects}: granted once per life when the last floor is cleared, if the delver's Comprehension is at least min_comprehension (otherwise they may try again at a later opening); effects use the shared Effects keys, usually learn_technique. notice_days (SECRET-003, optional, default 30, 0 = no notice): word of the opening spreads this many days before it, to cultivators the barrier admits. entry_item (REALM-002, optional): an item id the delver must hold to find the way in on the first entry of each opening (check_enter refuses without it, the journal says '(needs <item>)'); consume_entry_item (optional bool) spends one on that entry. rivals (W-005f, top level): on each floor entered, with chance_per_floor a rival cultivator of the realm's range (a generated NPC who then lives in the realm's region) contests the treasure: beat them (a non-lethal fight) and you spare them, earning spare_gratitude gratitude (rob or kill them later from their NPC menu if you wish); lose and they take the floor. When an opening closes before you have cleared the last floor, a rival claims the realm's inheritance for good with inheritance_claim_chance (unless you already hold it).

realms.name: Verdant Remnant
realms.description: The drifting pocket garden of a fallen herb sect, which surfaces in the Misty Forest for two months every few years.

inheritance.name: Legacy of the Verdant Sect
inheritance.text: Among the pavilion's roots a jade slip pulses with green light, and the breathing art of a whole lost sect flows into your mind.

floors.name: Overgrown Gardens
floors.text: Spirit herbs choke the old terraces, and something grey stalks between them.

floors.name: Collapsed Library
floors.text: Shelves of rotted bamboo slips. Another treasure hunter got here first, and does not intend to share.

floors.name: Heart Pavilion
floors.text: At the garden's heart a stone ape guards a pavilion still thick with qi.

realms.name: Sunken Sword Tomb
realms.description: Once a decade the mists over Azure Peak part to reveal the tomb of a sword immortal's disciples. The way in is hidden; only a surviving map fragment shows where the sword-marks lead.

inheritance.name: Sword Master's Inheritance
inheritance.text: As the python falls, the coffin's lid slides aside. A last strand of sword intent left by the tomb's master tests your heart, and finds it worthy.

floors.name: Hall of Broken Blades
floors.text: A stone guardian still patrols among a thousand shattered swords.

floors.name: Blood-Stained Corridor
floors.text: A demonic cultivator has been feeding on the trapped souls here.

floors.name: Sword Master's Coffin
floors.text: A jade python has coiled itself around the coffin of the tomb's master.

realms.name: Peach Blossom Grotto
realms.description: Every three springs a crack opens in the hill behind Qingshi, breathing out the scent of peach blossoms that never wilt.

floors.name: Blossom Path
floors.text: Petals drift over a path no one has walked in a century. A fox watches from the branches.

floors.name: Hermit's Hut
floors.text: A hut with a cold stove and a guest who refuses to leave.

floors.name: Peach Tree of the Immortal
floors.text: An ancient peach tree heavy with fruit that glows faintly.

realms.name: Fallen Star Vault
realms.description: Beneath the crater that gave the market its name lies a vault of star-metal, and every eight years its seals weaken.

floors.name: Star-Iron Corridor
floors.text: Walls of fused star metal hum with old formations. Something bronze walks the halls.

floors.name: Hall of Meteor Shards
floors.text: Shards of a burned-out star float in the air, too hot to touch.

floors.name: Starfall Treasury
floors.text: The vault's treasury, guarded by a cultivator who has lived here since the star fell.

floors.name: Heart of the Star
floors.text: At the vault's heart the star's core still glows, and the qi is thick enough to drink.

inheritance.name: Starfall Sword Intent
inheritance.text: In the star's core a sword intent waits, sharp as falling light. It enters your sea of consciousness and stays.

realms.name: Drowned Yin Palace
realms.description: A palace of a forgotten Yin King lies under the Withered Bone Marsh. Once in a dozen years the water draws back from its gates.

floors.name: Flooded Gate
floors.text: The gate is half underwater, and the drowned still stand guard.

floors.name: Hall of Black Water
floors.text: Black water fills the hall to the knees; a toad the size of a house sits in it.

floors.name: Corpse Gardens
floors.text: Rows of preserved corpses, each holding a jade token. A bear king guards the rows.

floors.name: Throne of the Yin King
floors.text: The Yin King's throne stands empty. His storm-roc still circles the ceiling.

floors.name: Yin King's Tomb
floors.text: The tomb itself, quiet as deep water. Nothing guards it but the cold.

inheritance.name: Yin King's Testament
inheritance.text: The Yin King's last words seep from the tomb into your bones: how a cultivator may walk between life and death. In the King's cold hand lies a slip of black jade: his method.

realms.name: Skyfall Thunder Pavilion
realms.description: A pavilion of black jade that fell from the heavens onto Myriad Peaks Ridge. Every sixteen years the lightning around it falls quiet and its doors open.

inheritance.name: Thunder Pavilion Master's Legacy
inheritance.text: The pavilion's last lightning bows to you and gathers into a single mark upon your palm.

floors.name: Gate of Falling Lightning
floors.text: A black-iron bear king has made its lair in the gateway where the first bolt struck, and it does not share.

floors.name: Hall of a Hundred Bolts
floors.text: A thunderwing roc nests among the pillars, its feathers crackling with the storm it feeds on.

floors.name: Throne of the Thunder Master
floors.text: The master's bones sit upright on the throne, and a cloud-devouring condor perches above them, swallowing the last of the storm.
